title: Scp-173 The Statue
style: dark anime key art, painterly cinematic horror illustration, a concrete-and-fluorescent-light government facility at night, moody lighting with deep shadows and one cold light source, rich detail, film still quality, vertical composition, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs with writing

credit.author: Moto42
credit.line: Based on SCP-173 by Moto42 - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-173 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: It only moves when you blink. Could you stare at it for one hour?

Hero.look: Foundation guard, about 28, black tactical uniform, ID badge on chest, tired red eyes, short dark hair

scenes.image_prompt: Low-angle shot of {Hero} in a dark concrete corridor, a faint rough concrete statue with rebar visible far behind, empty dark space above for a title, {style}

lines.text: There is a statue locked in a room at Site-19, and it is alive. A secret organization that locks away things that should not exist calls it SCP-173.

scenes.label: WHAT IT DOES
scenes.image_prompt: {Hero} staring ahead in a bare concrete cell, small rough concrete statue with rebar and flecks of spray paint far in the background corner, {style}

lines.text: It is concrete and rebar, and it cannot move while you look at it. The moment you look away, it can.

scenes.label: WHY IT'S DANGEROUS
scenes.image_prompt: Concrete floor stained reddish brown with blood, the concrete statue half hidden at the edge of frame, a guard's boots nearby, {style}

lines.text: And it kills, snapping necks at the base of the skull, and its floor is stained with blood and filth.

scenes.label: HOW IT'S CONTAINED
scenes.image_prompt: Heavy steel door ajar, three guards including {Hero} entering a dim cell, the concrete statue visible as a small shape in the dark gap, {style}

lines.text: So it stays in a locked container, and nobody enters with fewer than three people.

scenes.label: WHO WATCHES IT
scenes.image_prompt: Two guards including {Hero} staring wide-eyed ahead, the concrete statue reflected in a guard's visor, slightly closer than before, {style}

lines.text: Two must stare at it without pause until everyone is out, and they warn each other before they blink.

scenes.label: THE MISTAKE
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of {Hero}'s eye mid-blink, blurred concrete statue with rebar glimpsed in the background at the edge, closer now, {style}

lines.text: But tonight you are one of the two, your eyes burn, and you blink without warning anyone.

scenes.image_prompt: {Hero} frozen, eyes open, in the dim cell, the concrete statue half hidden in shadow a few steps behind, scrape marks on the floor, {style}

lines.text: Nothing happens, which means it already moved: scraping stone, much too close.

scenes.image_prompt: {Hero} unaware in the foreground, the huge concrete statue with rebar and spray paint flecks looming right behind, in sharp focus, arms reaching toward the neck, {style}

lines.text: Turn around. I am right here, inches from your neck. Go on... blink. Would you survive one blink in there?
